name.zh-CN: 调阅急性期血细胞与溶血记录

zh-CN: 调阅急性期血细胞与溶血记录

text.zh-CN: 急变时 Hb 69 g/L、PLT 7×10⁹/L、LDH 919 U/L，外周血破碎红细胞 8%；Coombs 阴性。
text.en: At deterioration Hb 69 g/L, platelets 7×10⁹/L, LDH 919 U/L and 8% schistocytes; Coombs was negative.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 抽搐时 CT/MRI 未见明显出血灶，有少量腔隙灶。
text.en: CT/MRI during seizures showed no obvious haemorrhage, with a few lacunar lesions.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 肾功能、凝血及多项自身抗体报告正常，骨髓红系及巨核细胞增生；这些不能单独确立 Evans 综合征。
text.en: Renal/coagulation studies and several autoimmune tests were reported normal, with erythroid and megakaryocytic marrow proliferation; these do not alone establish Evans syndrome.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 血浆置换后反复复发，后加利妥昔单抗并继续激素，血细胞稳定约一年半后再次复发；复发时 ADAMTS13 12%。再次置换与利妥昔单抗后缓解，缓解后 ADAMTS13 未复查。
text.en: Repeated relapse followed plasma exchange. Rituximab plus continued steroids preceded about 18 months of count stability, then another relapse with ADAMTS13 12%. Further exchange/rituximab produced remission; remission ADAMTS13 was not rechecked.

hint.zh-CN: 指出支持证据、反证和仍需核对的信息。

prompt.zh-CN: 目前应优先识别什么综合征？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 血栓性微血管病，临床高度怀疑 TTP
text.en: Thrombotic microangiopathy with high clinical suspicion of TTP

feedback.zh-CN: 严重血小板减少、碎片性溶血及神经症状相互支持。
feedback.en: Severe thrombocytopenia, fragmentation haemolysis and neurological symptoms are concordant.

text.zh-CN: 孤立免疫性血小板减少即可解释
text.en: Isolated immune thrombocytopenia explains everything

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释明显碎片性溶血和器官症状。
feedback.en: It does not explain marked fragmentation haemolysis and organ symptoms.

text.zh-CN: Coombs 阴性足以证明没有溶血
text.en: Negative Coombs excludes haemolysis

feedback.zh-CN: 它不排除非免疫性微血管性溶血。
feedback.en: It does not exclude non-immune microangiopathic haemolysis.

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样避免等待检查造成延误？
prompt.en: How can investigation-related delay be avoided?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 立即请血液团队按疑似 TTP 组织救治，并在可行时先留取 ADAMTS13 标本
text.en: Urgently involve haematology for suspected TTP care and obtain pretreatment ADAMTS13 sampling when feasible

feedback.zh-CN: 需要专科紧急路径，不能等所有确证结果才行动。
feedback.en: Urgent specialist care should not await all confirmatory results.

text.zh-CN: 等五联征全部出现才处理
text.en: Wait for the full pentad

feedback.zh-CN: 完整五联征不是行动前提。
feedback.en: The complete pentad is not a prerequisite.

text.zh-CN: 仅因肾功能正常而排除 TTP
text.en: Exclude TTP because renal function is normal

feedback.zh-CN: 肾功能正常不排除该病。
feedback.en: Normal renal function does not exclude it.

prompt.en: How should later ADAMTS13 activity of 12% be interpreted?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 结果接近但不满足典型严重缺乏阈值，需核对采样时点、抑制物及其他 TMA
text.en: It is near but not below the usual severe-deficiency threshold; timing, inhibitors and other TMA need review

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把 12% 改写为 <10%，也不能忽略治疗影响。
feedback.en: Do not rewrite 12% as <10% or ignore treatment effects.

text.zh-CN: 12% 就是已记录 <10%
text.en: 12% is equivalent to a documented <10%

text.zh-CN: 血常规恢复就无需后续专科监测

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 临床 TTP 样微血管病反复发作；后续 ADAMTS13 结果和疗效均需保留采样及联合治疗限制。
conclusion.en: A recurrent clinical TTP-like microangiopathy; later ADAMTS13 and response require attention to sampling and combined-treatment limitations.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 碎片性溶血改变孤立血小板减少的鉴别。
keyReasoning.en: Fragmentation haemolysis changes the differential of thrombocytopenia.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: ISTH 2020/2025 支持紧急专科路径及 ADAMTS13 评估。
keyReasoning.en: ISTH 2020/2025 supports urgent specialist pathways and ADAMTS13 assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 联合治疗后的缓解不能单独归因于某一药物。
keyReasoning.en: Remission after combined treatment cannot be attributed to one drug alone.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 首次 ADAMTS13、抑制物、后续检测与置换相对时点及缓解活性未载。
unknowns.en: Initial ADAMTS13, inhibitors, sampling relative to exchange and remission activity are absent.
